text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a safe flip for CONFIG_GATE=kv_prefetch_v2 tonight during the 11pm-1am quiet window. Want to coordinate who’s pushing and smoke checklist.
maria: I can own the flip and initial smoke. aiming for 11:15pm PT.
jamal: I can be on rollback standby and watch latency dashboards.
sylvia: I’ll run canary traffic (5% EU, 5% US) for 20m after flip and report errors.
alex: thanks. safe defaults = OFF for any tenant without explicit opt-in, and kill-switch path is /admin/flags/reset/kv_prefetch_v2.
maria: putting deploy steps below — copy+pasted for quick run:```bash
# from deploy user
export GATE=kv_prefetch_v2
./flagctl flip --gate $GATE --env prod --set on --target-tenants 5pct_canary
# verify rollout state
./flagctl status --gate $GATE
```
jamal: good. smoke checklist: 1) prod error rate <= baseline+0.5% 2) tail latency (p99) <= baseline+30ms 3) no increase in model OOMs 4) logs show cache-hit% increase for canary tenants
sylvia: add: verify canary tenants' request paths include x-tenant-prefetch header, and check that KV cache size stays stable in GKE nodes.
maria: I’ll post results in thread after 20m. if any check fails we flip back to OFF and escalate to eng-runtime.
alex: rollback command (in case):```bash
./flagctl flip --gate kv_prefetch_v2 --env prod --set off --force
```
deploy-bot: scheduled flip job queued by maria at 2024-11-07T23:15:00Z (job id fb-7731). :white_check_mark:
jamal: can everyone confirm they’ll be reachable on Slack + pager for the window?
alex: I’ll be on slack and reachable by phone.
sylvia: yes, I’ll monitor dashboards and post screenshots if anything odd.
maria: confirmed. will kick at 11:15pm PT and update here immediately. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks team — after canary looks good we’ll ramp to 50% then full over 2 hours (manual steps), documented rollback policy applies.
sylvia: noted. I’ll prepare a short watch doc and attach screenshots to this thread.
maria: flipping in ~10.
